scope.selection_reason: This was the final Route 1 material still using diagnostic preview rendering. Its exact named programs prove that the sign is a lit, rimmed FieldObjectShader surface rather than an unlit single-texture prop.

source_textures.runtime_note: The exact red-channel curve is byte-identical to the lighttable01_t curve recovered for FieldRockShader and reuses its exact texel interpolation.

canonical_atlas_orientation.canonical_decode: The cooker emits top-down RGBA rows, so the source vertical convention is already represented by the decoded row order.
canonical_atlas_orientation.runtime_coordinate: canonical UV0 without a second V inversion
canonical_atlas_orientation.front_panel_canonical_pixel_region: approximately x 12-94, y 169-249 in the decoded 256x256 top-down atlas
canonical_atlas_orientation.rejected_mapping: Applying 1-V again selects approximately y 7-86 and incorrectly places the upper-left back-face artwork on the front panel.

surface_order: Texture01 times source automatic-shadow color window
plus RimColor times recovered view-dependent rim window
recovered_fragment_contract.lighting_order: mix(Shadow_Color, white, minimum(shadow toon times depth PCF, projected cloud))
recovered_fragment_contract.output_rgb: lighting times surface times source Color0 times OnGameColor
recovered_fragment_contract.output_alpha: Texture01 alpha times Color0 alpha times Transparent times OnGameAlpha
source_neutral_terms: ShadowColor is white, so the enabled automatic-shadow color window is neutral for this material
OnGameColor is white, so the enabled OnGameColor multiplier is neutral for this material

implementation.adapter_contract: The exact material name, shader group, five source bindings, colors, values, and switches must match before mode 17 is selected.

tests: The strict LGPE WorldScene sign fixture and deterministic CPU fragment oracle pass.
The canonical top-down sign atlas contract rejects a duplicate runtime V inversion.
The D3D12 mode-17 fixed-root payload contract passes.
All four Vulkan world fragment variants compile.
The complete Route 1 qualification passes with material modes 4 through 17.
The exact sign filter reports 1 group, 462 triangles, and 9/9 runtime mip chains.
PAC_LgpeInspect reports zero preview-only material records.

open_boundaries: The shared ten-tap projected depth-shadow PCF and projected cloud multiplier are held fully lit until their shared matrices and live frame resources are represented.
Native fog and post-processing remain outside this material-local pass.
No local wind, billboard, or inferred deformation is added because the recovered vertex program contains none.
